problemsFound: About item 2 said she made 'seven buttercream wedding cakes'. The PEOPLE/AOL article never calls the wedding cakes buttercream; it only calls her 'the buttercream specialist behind Lucy Jane Cakes'. Rewritten to what the article says: seven cakes, a three-tier vanilla main cake plus six other flavours, for her wedding in London on 7 Dec 2024, finished two days before.
About item 4 combined TikTok stats with the PEOPLE Instagram figure under a single TikTok sourceUrl. Split into two items, each with its own source.
About item 5 listed four how-to topics but cited only the photo-cake video. Narrowed to what that video supports; the other topics stay in the videos list with their own URLs.

About item 6 cited the 'ALL THE PINKS' video for #londoncakes, #lambethcake and #southwoodford, but that caption has only #essexcakes. Those three tags are in the 'Rainbows and unicorns' caption. Split into two correctly sourced items.

Service 'Buttercream celebration cakes' was sourced to AOL but also claimed 'colourful buttercream pipework' and 'orders by Instagram DM', which AOL does not say. Rewritten to AOL content only; Instagram-DM ordering stays in about, sourced to the TikTok bio.
Service 'Themed and character cakes' cited the Spider-Man video for unicorn and cowgirl cakes too. Narrowed to the Spider-Man cake, with the other examples left in the videos list.

Service 'Heart cakes' described video content ('pink buttercream heart cakes shown') that can only be confirmed from the caption and cover frame. Reworded to the caption plus the visible cover: a two-tier smooth pink cake.

Videos said LJC10 / LUCYJANE10 were 'the creator's own discount codes'. They are codes for third-party suppliers: cake boards from @OLBAA, a scraper and toppers from @LissieLou. Corrected, and the 'ALL THE PINKS' toppers are now attributed to the supplier.

Missed own footage: the PEOPLE/AOL article links TikTok video 7473914061248269590 ('Worst experience with a bride…', 21 Feb 2025, 75s, about 50.9K plays, #weddingcake). It shows her own three-tier white wedding cake being finished. Added to videos, and its cover added to images.

Namesake detail was wrong. Lucy Jane Cake Company (lucyjanecakecompany.co.uk) states its studio collection point is in Milton Keynes, not just 'Buckinghamshire'. Its logo is a navy and gold 'LJ' monogram, its rebrand was in 2024 (from 'Forget Me Not Cakery By Lu'), and it has been baking since 2013. That confirms it is a different business from the listing, whose pink logo matches @lucy_jane_cakes exactly.

Two image covers show personal names on cake toppers: a child's name and '14' on the cowgirl cake, and a name on the rainbow cake. Added a privacy note to crop or avoid them. The cowgirl frame also shows the baker herself.
Logo 2 'background' is opaque light blush pink. 'white' is kept as the closest allowed value and explained in the notes.

identity.evidence: Checked again on 27 Oct 2026. The Booked Events listing (https://bookedevents.co.uk/businesses/lucy-jane-cakes/) returns 200. It is marked 'Not Verified', says Est.2014 and Essex, was listed 22 Oct 2024 and last updated 12 Jan 2025. Its logo, lucy_jane_cakes.png (500x500 RGBA, wp-image-10161), is a blush-pink circle with 'LUCY JANE' in white capitals and 'Cakes' in pink script. That mark is identical to the 629x629 TikTok avatar of @lucy_jane_cakes (nickname Lucy_Jane_Cakes). The TikTok bio reads 'Lucy Jane Cakes / London / Message on Instagram for orders' and links to instagram.com/lucy_jane_cakes. The listing cover photo, cakes.jpg, shows pink rosette cupcakes with small cards bearing the same pink circular 'LUCY' mark. PEOPLE/AOL (27 Feb 2025) calls her 'the buttercream specialist behind Lucy Jane Cakes' and links both @lucy_jane_cakes accounts. The trade matches (cake maker). The location fits: the TikTok bio says London, and captions use #essexcakes, #southwoodford, #londoncakes and #lambethcake. The year does not match: the listing says Est.2014, while PEOPLE says she began selling cakes professionally in 2016. No official website exists. The listing's 'Visit Website' anchor has no href, and lucyjanecakes.co.uk/.com/.uk/.london and lucy-jane-cakes.co.uk/.com have no DNS. Companies House search shows no 'Lucy Jane Cakes' company. Namesake ruled out: Lucy Jane Cake Company (lucyjanecakecompany.co.uk) collects from a studio in Milton Keynes, uses a navy and gold 'LJ' monogram logo and rebranded in 2024 from 'Forget Me Not Cakery By Lu', so it is a different business.

about.text: PEOPLE describes her as 'the buttercream specialist behind Lucy Jane Cakes' and says she has baked her entire life and began selling cakes professionally in 2016.

A PEOPLE exclusive, republished on AOL on 27 Feb 2025, reported that she made seven wedding cakes for her own London wedding on 7 December 2024. The main cake was a three-tier classic vanilla sponge, with six other flavours, and all seven were finished two days before the wedding.
In February 2025 PEOPLE reported that she had 105,000 Instagram followers and nearly 200,000 TikTok followers.
The TikTok bio reads 'Lucy Jane Cakes / London / Message on Instagram for orders', so orders are taken by Instagram message.
The TikTok account @lucy_jane_cakes showed about 193.6K followers, 5.5M likes and 513 videos when fetched on 27 Oct 2026.
The account posts cake-decorating how-to videos. One is a photo-cake tutorial that names the Wilton 199 and Jen 2ES nozzles she used.
The 'Rainbows and unicorns' video caption is tagged #londoncakes, #lambethcake and #southwoodford.
Other captions use #essexcakes, for example the 'ALL THE PINKS' video.
The Booked Events listing gives Est.2014 and location Essex. It is marked 'Not Verified' and lists an event size of 10–100 guests.

record.instagramAccess: One plain unauthenticated GET to https://www.instagram.com/lucy_jane_cakes/ with a desktop User-Agent (27 Oct 2026) returned HTTP 200 with no redirect. The body was a ~505KB generic app shell titled 'Instagram', with no og: or description meta tags, no bio, follower count or posts. Profile content is not readable without login, and I did not retry. The handle is confirmed by the TikTok bioLink and by the PEOPLE/AOL article's links.
gaps: No official website. The Booked Events 'Visit Website' anchor has no href. lucyjanecakes.co.uk/.com/.uk/.london, lucy-jane-cakes.co.uk/.com and lucyjanecakesltd.co.uk have no DNS. linktr.ee/lucy_jane_cakes and linktr.ee/lucyjanecakes return 404. No 'Lucy Jane Cakes' company appears in a Companies House name search.

Establishment year conflict: the listing says Est.2014, while PEOPLE says she began selling cakes professionally in 2016 (it also mentions brownies that 'started in 2008'). The 2014 date is unverified.

Exact base town not verified. The TikTok bio says London and the listing says Essex. Hashtags include #essexcakes, #southwoodford, #londoncakes and #lambethcake. PEOPLE names London only as the wedding location.
Price: '£50 per event' appears only on the unverified Booked Events listing. The business publishes no prices.

Event types are not stated by the business, so eventTypes is left empty. Wedding cakes for clients are not confirmed: PEOPLE and the #weddingcake TikTok cover only her own wedding. Birthday-style cakes appear in videos, but she never names the events she serves.
Instagram bio and posts are not viewable without login. The 105K follower figure is from PEOPLE (Feb 2025) only.
No Facebook page confirmed. One plain request to facebook.com/lucyjanecakes returned HTTP 400, not retried. facebook.com/LucyJanesCakes is reported as a different business and was not fetched.
No YouTube channel found. youtube.com/@lucy_jane_cakes returns a 302 to the Google consent wall, which was not bypassed. Web search found no channel.
No direct video files. TikTok playAddr returned 403 to a cookieless Range request, and TikTok oEmbed returned 429 (not retried). Use TikTok embeds, or footage the business supplies with permission.

Logo: no SVG exists. The best assets are the 500x500 transparent PNG from Booked Events and the 629x629 TikTok avatar on pink. A crisp large logo needs a faithful vector redraw or the original artwork from the business.

Photos: the only non-TikTok image is the 500x455 listing cover. The TikTok covers are 540x960 signed URLs that expire around 29 Oct 2026, so they must be re-fetched or re-hosted with permission. The rainbow and cowgirl covers show personal names on cakes or toppers; crop or avoid them.

The repo entry in src/data/vendors.ts (lines 117-129) is unsourced and conflicts with the evidence: established 2016, price_from 350, rating 4.9, review_count 41, verified true, and an Unsplash stock image_url. Ratings, review counts and 'verified' have no source and should not be published.

docs/reference/bookedevents-cards-parsed-20250331.json has its card links offset by one. The 'Lucy Jane Cakes' card (index 7) links to /businesses/ray-johnson/ and the 'Jocee' card (index 6) links to /businesses/lucy-jane-cakes/. The correct listing URL is https://bookedevents.co.uk/businesses/lucy-jane-cakes/.

Namesakes to avoid: Lucy Jane Cake Company (lucyjanecakecompany.co.uk, Milton Keynes studio, navy and gold LJ monogram, instagram.com/lucyjanecakecompany, verified by fetch). Also reported from search snippets only and not fetched: Lucy Jane's Cakes (Lane End, Bucks; facebook.com/LucyJanesCakes), Lucy Jane's Bakery (Potton) and Instagram @lucyscakesxx. Companies House also lists LUCY JANES BAKERY LTD (London W1W, dissolved May 2026), with no evidence of a link.
